category: map tiles and US elevation API

free_tier.stated: Personal plan, free: 50,000 API requests for the Elevation API and 50,000 tile requests for each of Basemap, Map Maker, Terrain Tiles and USGS Topo Maps, with 8¢ charged per additional 1,000 requests; the pricing page states no period for the Personal column (the paid columns are per month), and a third-party listing reads the quotas as monthly
free_tier.notes: the Standard plan is $25.00 a month for 100,000 API requests; whether the Personal plan can be billed for the overage, and so whether a card is asked, is unverified; the service is tiles and elevation, not a geocoder

per_object_cap.stated: the Elevation API takes a single latitude and longitude pair or an array of up to 100 pairs in one query, for locations in the United States

retention.stated: unverified: no storage or caching rule for results or tiles was found

egress.terms: not applicable: requests, not bytes, are the metered unit

interface_detail: HTTPS microservices authorised with an x-api-key header or an OAuth 2 client-credentials access token exchanged from API credentials; tile endpoints addressed by z, x and y for basemap, terrain and USGS topo layers, and an Elevation API; the docs are at docs.clockworkmicro.com
tooling: any HTTP client; a no-code Map Maker tool on the site
chaining: 50,000 elevation lookups or tile requests per service on a free personal account whose form has no card field, with overage priced at 8¢ per 1,000: a US elevation API and a basemap for web maps, not a geocoder; the vendor does not state the free period
